::: {.section-intro}
## Research areas

Four themes organise the programme from sensing and reasoning through autonomy, connectivity, and real-world robotic systems.
:::

::: {.theme-grid}
::: {.theme-card}
<span class="theme-card__number">01</span>
### Connected Robotics
Networked, cooperative, and communication-aware robotic systems.

[Explore the theme →](research/connected-robotics.qmd)
:::
::: {.theme-card}
<span class="theme-card__number">02</span>
### Spatial Intelligence
Localisation, perception, spatial reasoning, and interaction with physical environments.

[Explore the theme →](research/spatial-intelligence.qmd)
:::
::: {.theme-card}
<span class="theme-card__number">03</span>
### Autonomous Systems
Planning, control, and decision-making for robots, vehicles, UAVs, and multi-agent systems.

[Explore the theme →](research/autonomous-systems.qmd)
:::
::: {.theme-card}
<span class="theme-card__number">04</span>
### 6G / AI-RAN
Intelligent radio-resource management, edge intelligence, and communication-aware autonomy.

[Explore the theme →](research/ai-ran-6g.qmd)
:::
:::
